data_provenance_status: EPW identity, hourly interval convention and geographic-north rotation are unconfirmed by the user. Exploratory fitting may proceed, but weather alignment and physical interpretation remain unverified.
task: Predict five hourly simulated performance metrics for four observed PVSD angles in unseen Tower A rooms

optional_ablations_after_core_comparison.window_representation: Compare nominal window area or WFR against Glass_Area_m2 without exhaustively searching combinations

preprocessing.periodic: Replace DOY with annual sin/cos; replace Solar_Azimuth with sin/cos. Document periods and angle convention. Hour can initially remain numeric over the retained daytime window.
preprocessing.regression_baseline: Standardize within each training fold; use a small predeclared set of angle/radiation and geometry/radiation interactions for a meaningful ridge baseline.
preprocessing.solar_to_facade_geometry: Do not compute relative solar azimuth or angle of incidence until the model-to-geographic-north transformation and PVSD geometry are confirmed.
preprocessing.targets: No target may be used as an input to another independent model. Clip predicted fractions to [0,1] and other targets to >=0; report pre-clipping violations. Fit any learned transform only on the fold training subset.

validation.method: 7-fold LeaveOneGroupOut on TRAIN rooms; all four angles and all hours of each validation room stay together
validation.selection: Select features/model settings using only development CV; macro-average errors over rooms for each target. Do not sum errors with incompatible physical units.
validation.early_stopping: Use an explicitly grouped validation split inside training folds, or disable estimator automatic random-row early stopping during this small first comparison.
validation.final_test_policy: Freeze all feature/model/scoring rules before final test performance evaluation. Keep original split; do not move an unusual test room into training after seeing results.

metrics.primary_regression: Room-wise MAE in lux, fraction percentage points, or hourly kWh as applicable
metrics.avoid: MAPE as a primary measure because targets contain many zero values
decision_evaluation: Score regret versus four-angle simulated reference
PV generation summed over retained hours
Near-optimal angle rate with predeclared tolerance
Switching count under a separately stated control assumption

known_covariate_coverage_limits.BM702: Orientation (-1,0) absent from TRAIN; new model-axis direction
known_covariate_coverage_limits.BMG26: Obstruction ratio above TRAIN maximum and floor 0 below TRAIN floor range 2..7
known_covariate_coverage_limits.building: 186 of 476 rooms have area outside the TRAIN univariate area range. A univariate in-range check alone does not establish multivariate coverage.

provenance_to_confirm_before_weather_cla: Exact EPW filename/hash and identity with weather used for the original PV and daylight simulations
EPW local standard time, endpoint convention and row-index mapping to HOY_0based
Solar midpoint timestamp, latitude, longitude, timezone, year/calendar and azimuth convention
Model axes to geographic north transformation
PV array area/capacity and modeling assumptions for each room
Whether TEST rooms were reserved before representative-room selection and how K-means preprocessing was fit
scope: Offline simulated performance prediction for the observed four angles and retained 07..18 hours. New weather years, other angles, other PVSD distances and actual dynamic operation are not validated.
